Name: JBT ES Seasonal Standing Portraits
Author: JBTmod
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This standalone content pack adds painted anime-style standing portraits to dialogue. Clothing, hairstyles and colors are based on Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for ESR. This release includes 12 characters and 48 portrait sheets. Expression cells retain the source portrait indices.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This standalone content pack adds painted anime-style standing portraits to dialogue. Clothing, hairstyles and colors are based on Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for ESR. This release includes 12 characters and 48 portrait sheets. Expression cells retain the source portrait indices.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This pack changes dialogue portraits only. It does not include character sprites, maps, the expansion itself, or prerequisites. Vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded characters are not included.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.
- Content Patcher 2.9.1 or later.
- Dialogue Display Framework Continued 0.7.5 or later.
- East Scarp and all of its requirements.
- Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for ESR and all of its requirements.
Download prerequisites from their original authors. They are not bundled.[/color]

[b]Credits and Acknowledgements[/b]
Thank you to LemurKat and the East Scarp team for creating East Scarp, its characters, and the original portraits used as character references.
Thank you to Drawberry138 for Drawberry’s Seasonal Cuter Characters for ESR, whose seasonal sprites were used as outfit and color references during the development of this portrait pack, and to Poltergeister for the Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic that inspired that work.
Credit also goes to the character designers acknowledged on Drawberry’s mod page: AttonBomb (Beatrice), ItsBenter (Corwin, Edith, Ethan, Michael, Stella, and Captain Rod), Airyn (Tristan), Fellowclown (Dale and Jade), Avis (Keanu), and Medisun (Kennedy).
Thank you to Pathoschild and the SMAPI and Content Patcher contributors, Mangupix for Dialogue Display Framework Continued, aedenthorn for the original Dialogue Display Framework, and Spiderbuttons for Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens.
The standing portrait artwork in this pack was created with AI assistance and subsequently organized, edited, and prepared for use in-game. This is an unofficial fan-made portrait pack. The credited creators have not endorsed this project, and credit does not imply permission or authorization.
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Close the game.
2. If installed, move the old combined "[CP] JBT ES RSV Seasonal Portraits" folder out of Mods. Store backups outside Mods.
3. Extract this archive and place "[CP] JBT ES Seasonal Portraits" in Mods.
4. Launch through SMAPI.
To update, replace the matching standalone folder. To uninstall, remove it.
The separate ES and RSV packs can be used together or separately. Do not use them alongside the old combined pack.[/color]
